name: Sol and Selene
notes: Store meta: Commerce, California, USD, ships to US, CA and one more (https://solandselene.com/meta.json). About: 'a Los Angeles-designed women's bags and accessories brand specializing in lightweight, functional bags made for everyday life' (https://www.solandselene.com/pages/about-us).

Free shipping via FedEx Home Delivery on all purchases in the continental U.S. (https://www.solandselene.com/policies/shipping-policy). Returns within 30 days minus a $4.99 return shipping fee; one free exchange per order (https://www.solandselene.com/policies/refund-policy).
